title: Amangqina Atshabaleleyo
intro: Kwixesha elidlulileyo, uluntu lwaluhlala kwindawo apho ubukhosi babuhlangana khona. Umprofeti wabo wababizela endleleni yenyaniso, kodwa babambelela ekungakholweni nasekucinezelweni. Eli bali liphela ngempindezelo kaThixo. Ungalibona eli lizwe kunye nesiphelo salo kwiindlela ezingezantsi?
clues: Abantu basichasa isilumkiso esasiziswa ngomnye wabathunywa babo.
Isithunywa sasibizela ukuba sinqule uAllah kuphela saza salumkisa nxamnye nokonakala.
Ukwaphula kwethu umthetho yayikukugatya umprofeti othunyelwe phakathi kwethu ngobulungisa.
Sasithandabuza igunya lomthunywa saza samtyhola ngokukhohlisa.
Isohlwayo safika kuthi ngelixa sasihlala ngokukhuselekileyo emakhayeni ethu.
Satshatyalaliswa ngenxa yokukhanyela umprofeti wethu nokutshutshisa amakholwa.
arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verse: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." (29:36)
